sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks sheet row 10 (check 9), Internal Quality Checks sheet row 10 (check 9), Deterministic Checks rows 19, 37, 41
evidence: task/task.toml:20-24 reads `[environment]` / `build_timeout_sec = 600.0` / `network_mode = "public"` / `cpus = 2` / `memory_mb = 4096`, identical to the frozen contract block in references/staged-task-contract.md:56-60 and to the frozen template task.toml (diff of template vs task task.toml differs only in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] fields; the [environment] table is byte-identical). `docker_image`, `allow_internet`, `allowed_hosts`, `gpus` and `storage_mb` are absent from task.toml (grep returned no match), as quality-checks.md:44 and staged-task-contract.md:78 require. No secret literal exists under [environment]; the only credential-shaped lines in the file are task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a ${VAR} template) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`, both in the frozen [verifier.env] block, which SKILL.md:66 lists as an expected non-finding. The agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty); it has no ENV/ARG credential, only `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules` (Dockerfile:3) and a placeholder git identity `turing@local.invalid` (Dockerfile:20). A case-insensitive scan of task/environment, task.toml and instruction.md for provider key shapes, PEM headers, api key, secret, password, token and bearer matched only ui.md:13 (the word 'tokens' in syntax-colouring prose) and the two task.toml lines above. seed_data.json is 149 bytes with no credentials. Sanity of 2 CPU / 4096 MB for the work: the image is node:22-bookworm-slim with express and better-sqlite3 preinstalled globally (Dockerfile:9-12); the reference stack in solution/app/package.json is React 19, Vite 7, TypeScript 5.9, Prettier, acorn and @lezer/html, a small single-page bundle for which 4 GB is comfortably above a Vite/tsc build's needs. network_mode = "public" at task.toml:22 and :38 is the project profile (SKILL.md:26, workbook Quality Checks row 10) and is not flagged; the Internal sheet's 'no-network' wording for check 9 is superseded by the client-facing row and the skill's delivery profile. Raw-evidence-index artifact hashes were recomputed with sha256sum and all 15 listed artifacts match. Limitation: this row is a static configuration check. No run in the evidence index exercised the declared limits (the scripted golden ran outside the Harbor resource envelope), so peak memory and CPU of an agent build under cpus=2/memory_mb=4096 are not measured; the values are judged sane by equality with the frozen template and by the size of the stack, not by measurement.
